description: Dienst Trinkwasser GeWAP-TAV Peitz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dservices-eu1.arcgis.com. Displays all geodata on the drinking water network of the GeWAP/TAV in the Peitz supply area. This also includes the house connections and the document links, which are not visible in the public view. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WFS-Service Drinking Water GeWAP-TAV Peitz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include TAV, ESRI, Peitz, infoFeatureAccessService, GeWAP, Wasserversorgung. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
